Antec C5 ARGB Constellation Series White Case Specifications

The Antec C5 ARGB is a high-airflow, dual-chamber mid-tower case that features a stunning 270° panoramic view. It is particularly famous for its incredible value, coming pre-installed with 7 ARGB PWM fans out of the box, providing a complete cooling solution and a vibrant light show immediately upon assembly.

Core Specifications

  • Case Type: Mid Tower

  • Dimensions: 469 x 285 x 400 mm (DWH)

  • Materials: Steel, Plastic, Tempered Glass

  • Motherboard Support: ATX, Micro-ATX, ITX

  • Color: White (with matching white fans and cables)

Cooling & Fans (7 Pre-installed)

  • Side: 3 x 120mm ARGB PWM Reverse Fans (Pre-installed)

  • Bottom: 3 x 120mm ARGB PWM Reverse Fans (Pre-installed)

  • Rear: 1 x 120mm ARGB PWM Fan (Pre-installed)

  • Total Fan Support: Up to 10 fans (Top, Bottom, Side, Rear)

Radiator Support

  • Top: 120 / 140 / 240 / 280 / 360mm

  • Bottom: 120 / 240 / 360mm

  • Side: 120 / 240mm

  • Rear: 120mm

Storage & Expansion
